I am leaving you with a firm and clear message, expressing my outrage at what happened and the pain of having to make that decision regarding my kitten.

Writing

I want to express my profound indignation and disappointment with the care I received at this veterinary clinic.

Due to the long weekend and holidays, my trusted veterinarian advised me to take my kitten to an emergency clinic, in this case, AniCura. I went there trusting that she would receive professional, sincere care, and above all, that her well-being would be her priority.

However, after two days of tests and hospitalization, the bill came to €700. What hurts and outrages me the most is not only the financial cost, but the feeling that, from the beginning, they knew my kitten's condition was irreversible and that the most humane option was euthanasia, but this reality was not communicated to me with the clarity and honesty that such a situation requires.

It had to be my trusted veterinarian who called the clinic and insisted until they finally told me the truth about her condition. After everything that had happened, I had to face the most painful decision: saying goodbye to my kitten and having her euthanized.

When you take your pet to the emergency vet, you do so out of worry, fear, and the hope of being able to help them. You have complete faith in the professionals and expect them to act with transparency, empathy, and always prioritizing the animal's well-being. That's why I find it especially painful to feel that such a difficult situation was prolonged without being given all the necessary information from the beginning to make an informed decision.

I don't question the need for tests when they are justified, but I do believe it is essential that owners be informed honestly about the prognosis, the real chances of recovery, and the available options, especially when it is an irreversible situation.

We took our dog Gus to the clinic 10 days ago for a herniated disc in his spine that left him paralyzed from the waist down. From the first day, they treated him very well, and he had to have surgery. Both Dr. Carlos and Dr. Miguel did an excellent job. So much so that today, after 9 days, my dog ​​is almost walking on his own. He still has a lot of rehabilitation ahead of him, but it has been a complete success. Thank you so much for everything you have done for Gus; we are very happy!

My dog ​​got very sick. But thanks to the team, today marks one year since her diagnosis, and she's getting a little better every day. They've given me the gift of quality time with my Khalesy. I can never thank them enough for the happiness they've given me just by seeing her day after day. THANK YOU FOR BEING SUCH WONDERFUL PROFESSIONALS AND KINDNESS.
GOD BLESS YOU

Amazing professional people! I spent six months with them—pre-operative, operative, and post-operative. I couldn't have left my little Trebol in better hands. Exquisite treatment...a 10 out of 10! I'm absolutely delighted.

My review is dedicated primarily to Carlos and Miguel, the two surgeons at the hospital, whom I want to thank for the care and professionalism with which you treated Phoski, our little four-legged friend. I also want to acknowledge your dedication to saving lives and for bringing joy back into our home. And finally, our gratitude to the other veterinarians in the hospital, as well as the assistants, for your compassion during difficult times.
The care my pet receives is always excellent.
My dog ​​developed a tumor and Santiago the vet was the best. They operated and everything went perfectly. Thank you so much!!!

We regret that your experience was not satisfactory and would like to know what happened and the reason for this review. It is important for us to know our customers' opinions and to review any aspects you feel were not adequate.

We would appreciate it if you would contact our hospital directly so we can learn more about your experience and assist you personally.

Thank you for helping us improve.
My surgery went very well, and my recovery was perfect too. The doctor was excellent, and the clinic was great; they were very attentive to the pets.

Hi Ricardo,
We were delighted to see such a positive review, thank you so much!
AniCura Benipeixcar Veterinary Hospital | 24-hour Emergency Service

Hi Davinia,
We're delighted that you're also satisfied! Thank you so much for this review!

Hi Rosa,
We're delighted that you're also satisfied! Thank you so much for this review!

One star, and only because I can't give it five.
My experience with this veterinary hospital was very negative. I took my cat there because he needed veterinary care, but they refused to treat him. They told me to find another hospital because they wouldn't take responsibility. They didn't even help me find another clinic when I was there in an emergency. I find it especially disappointing that, given that my animal needed care, I wasn't offered a suitable solution or an alternative for receiving assistance.

As a pet owner, you go to a veterinary hospital expecting professionalism, empathy, and, above all, concern for the animal's well-being. In this case, I left feeling like I hadn't received the care I expected.

I hope they review how they handle these kinds of situations so that other animals and their owners don't have to go through a similar experience. The women who attended to me (if you can even call them that) had wavy hair, a bun, and tattoos.
I would definitely never take my pet to this place… They only serve the people they want, and only when it suits them. They make you wait a very long time.

We regret that your experience was not satisfactory and would like to know what happened and the reason for this review. It is important for us to know our customers' opinions and to review any aspects you feel were not adequate.

We would appreciate it if you would contact our hospital directly so we can learn more about your experience and assist you personally.

Thank you for helping us improve.

I'm sharing my experience; it's very sad. I'm giving it one star because there's no other option. It's a veterinary clinic that only cares about billing. Please, let's hope no one else has to go through what we did. Four dogs have died, and all four came out dead. The last one died two days ago, but this one left home fine. We took her because we saw she was having trouble breathing, and since she'd had surgery four weeks prior for an exorbitant fee, we thought it was a good idea. But no, in the end, they killed her too. We're requesting her entire medical history to confirm that they killed her. Even during the stitching, we saw a lack of professionalism. I hope this terrible experience we had at this place doesn't happen to anyone else. Please don't take your pet there; look for another place.
Professional service, very friendly and they answered my questions.
Very good experience

We were on vacation and had to take our dog to the vet due to an unexpected problem. From the very first moment, we received excellent treatment from the entire team. They were very attentive, professional, and kept us informed at all times, which is so appreciated when you're away from home and worried about your pet. I would recommend them without hesitation!

Hi M,
We're so glad your experience with us was positive!
Thank you for taking a few minutes to leave us a review.
AniCura Benipeixcar Veterinary Hospital | 24-hour Emergency Service

There are veterinarians who care for your animals, and then there are people who also care for you. ❤️
The Anicura Benipeixcar clinic
They have been with Teo through more than seven surgeries, by our side during very difficult times, and always with an attention, patience, and humanity that mean so much to me.

And this past week, with Holly, we went through another very complicated time. After everything that happened, Miguel listened to me, assessed the risks, and made a prudent decision: to wait, monitor the situation, and give it time. Today, we can finally say that everything has turned out in the best possible way. ❤️

I can only feel immense gratitude for all of you. Thank you for taking care of my dogs, but above all, thank you for taking care of me too. Thank you Miguel, Carlos, Paloma, Pax, Carmen, María, Natalia, Santi, and also all the members of the team whose names I may not remember, but who have always treated me and supported me as if we were family.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. You are so much more than just a veterinary clinic to us. ❤️
Exceptional care, Marvel needed thorough care for his little teeth and thanks to Yaiza's affection he behaved like a champion

The receptionists were very kind, and the veterinarians treated Dira with both love and professionalism. They kept us very well informed during her hospital stay, and it was clear she received excellent care.
Very friendly and attentive staff 🙏🏼 …

Thank you so much for your professionalism; we are truly delighted with your services.
I highly recommend your facilities, and we will definitely return because it's well worth it.

I'm delighted with the care we've received from them for all our dogs, both in emergencies and when my mastiff had surgery for dysplasia. We saw improvements from the very first moment. The attention from everyone at the clinic is fantastic, especially from Miguel, Carlos, and Paloma. I would recommend them a thousand times over.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at this veterinary hospital, and especially to Miguel and Carlos.
I took my dog ​​in for surgery to correct a malformation in her leg. It wasn't an easy process at all; there were some difficult moments, and she even had to undergo a second operation to ensure everything was correct. Throughout the entire process, Miguel and Carlos were there, providing constant support, reassuring her, and demonstrating exceptional professionalism and affection.

Today, my dog ​​is doing wonderfully, fully recovered, and walking beautifully. Thank you both so much for being so attentive every step of the way and for taking such dedicated care of her.

Hi Pamela,
We were so happy to see such a positive review, thank you so much!
AniCura Benipeixcar Veterinary Hospital | 24-hour Emergency Service

Don't even think about taking your pet there! I took my cat because he wasn't eating, and the first thing they asked for was the price: one hour, on Sunday, August 30, 2026. After several hours, the diagnosis was cystitis. When I took him home, his eyes were incredibly swollen, and the next day I called them, and they told me it was a lubricant to sedate him. The cat got worse and was in terrible shape. I paid 440 euros, and if they had actually cured him, great, but they didn't; they left him much worse than before. I had to take him to the Emergency Room at the Veterinary Hospital of the Catholic University of Valencia, and after many tests, they realized he had swollen lymph nodes and that it wasn't cystitis at all. They also found that Anicura had caused ulcers in his eyes, for which I'm now treating him with eye drops and antibiotics. I highly recommend this Veterinary Hospital of the Catholic University. They have excellent specialists and are very affordable.

⭐ 1 star, and only because I can't give it less.

If I have to highlight something positive, it's the attention from the veterinarian Marie, who the day before explained everything very well and clearly regarding the ultrasound my dog ​​Kira had. In that respect, I was very satisfied.

With the CT scan, however, everything was completely different.

I took Kira in for a CT scan, a necessary test to decide how to proceed with her treatment. What I find particularly unacceptable is that I wasn't informed until after the CT scan was performed and I had paid for it that the results wouldn't be available immediately, but that I would have to wait 24 hours because they had to send them for interpretation. They should have given me that information before I paid for the test, so I could decide if it was in my best interest to have it done there.

Furthermore, I had surgery scheduled for the next day, so I needed to have the results in time.

First they told me 24 hours, then 24-30 hours, and finally, I had to wait more than 48 hours to receive the report.

I understand that delays can happen, but I don't find it acceptable that the client isn't informed from the beginning and that the deadlines keep being extended when you're waiting for results that are essential for making decisions about your pet's health.

This whole situation has made me extremely distrustful. Ultimately, Kira needed chemotherapy, and I've decided to continue her treatment at another hospital because, after what happened with the CT scan, I no longer feel confident doing it here.

This experience has left me feeling incredibly helpless and, frankly, has made me lose all faith in this clinic.

The beauty of life is being honest. I took my cat in for an emergency. The service was excellent, I'm not denying that, but almost the entire consultation was based on the budget (money), like just another vet. In moments of distress, anything goes, but to make the cost seem more credible, when I paid, they charged me for things like the X-rays, ultrasound, and IV drip treatments. To be honest, they charged me for things I don't know if my cat actually received because they wouldn't let me in. I apologize; this is just a suggestion, but I would definitely go back. Best regards...

You charged me €1,600 and hospitalized him twice for the same thing: a urethral obstruction. I went to the emergency room and we waited four hours, knowing what was wrong with him and having his three most recent reports, tests, ultrasounds, and struvite culture in your database. Even so, you didn't do anything good for him, only cause him more pain and suffering. You saw him three times in six weeks, catheterized him twice, and he was hospitalized for a total of four days. The medication didn't work after he was discharged. I spoke with the surgeon, and he refused to operate, saying it was risky. All of this was to make us come back in worse condition. I find the treatment of both animals and people degrading. He was discharged on Sunday, and on Tuesday we had to take him to another clinic so he could receive proper care and the surgery he urgently needs. I will never return to this clinic; it's the worst treatment any animal could receive.
We went in for an emergency with our dog, and they attended to us quite quickly and very well. The service was excellent both at reception and during the consultation.

I don't like the idea of ​​Benipeixcar becoming part of a business holding company. I liked it the way it was before. Although I haven't noticed any changes yet. I'll be keeping an eye on things, because these things often have consequences.

Hi Rosa,
We were delighted to see such a positive review, thank you so much!
AniCura Benipeixcar Veterinary Hospital | 24-hour Emergency Service

Hi Mariola,
Thank you for this excellent review.

Have a great day!

I'm not giving them a lower rating because it won't let me.
I find it appalling that you go to a 24-hour emergency clinic and they tell you they can't treat your pet in an emergency because they're full. This wouldn't happen with people, which shows how little they value animals.

We went with Robi, our two-and-a-half-month-old puppy who had contracted parvovirus, and they completely saved his life. Besides that, they treated him like he was their own dog. They were also incredibly attentive, calling us every day to keep us updated on his condition. Thank you so much for everything you did.

Words cannot express our gratitude for the care we received at this 24-hour veterinary hospital. We rushed our dog, Kosmo, in because he had swallowed a stone.
From the very first moment, we were attended to by surgeon Carlos, a true professional with immense dedication. He was incredibly kind and attentive, explaining the situation and the necessary steps in detail. To avoid invasive and dangerous surgery for our dog, he assessed the case and successfully removed the stone endoscopically, literally saving Kosmo's life.

We are deeply grateful for his speed and incredible work. Carlos and the entire team have earned a very special place in our hearts; we will never forget what they did for our dog. Thank you so much!!!!❤️❤️❤️
Excellent service and reasonable prices. He's my trusted veterinarian.

I can't speak highly of this veterinary clinic.
Poor service
No empathy
Unfortunate medical treatment
🌈

Anicura Veterinary Hospital Benipeixcar.

I took my 4-week-old kitten to the vet for pneumonia, although they weren't sure of the diagnosis. The vet showed very little empathy and insisted on admitting him, but I refused because I told her I had oxygen at home. Fortunately, I took him home, and he recovered. The next day, I went to my regular vet, who told me they had given him unnecessary medication. And then there was the €187 consultation fee. I'll never go back.

So many compliments!
We are so happy for your loyalty, and the entire team at AniCura Benipeixcar Veterinary Hospital | 24-hour Emergency Care thanks you for your trust.
An extraordinary and very kind team, thank you for your professional attention.

Hello,
Thank you for leaving these reviews, which help us improve our service.

Thank you so much for your visit!

We are very satisfied with all the professionals at the hospital. This is the second time our dog has been hospitalized, and we are delighted. They have been very involved and have provided excellent follow-up care for Koke after the operation.

The treatment of both the dog and us has been outstanding. Highly recommended; we will definitely continue to choose them.

Wonderful professionals, impeccable service and personal quality from every single staff member. Even in our case, when the diagnosis was unfavorable, I only have words of gratitude for their kindness, their respect for our privacy during decision-making, and their support until the very end. Thank you so much for how you treated Golfo.

We received excellent treatment; the staff were professional and very friendly with both patients and owners. They gave me peace of mind and confidence in my pet's diagnosis. I am very grateful and very satisfied with the treatment.

Words cannot express my gratitude for everything you have done for Tommy. This is the second time you have saved his life. The first time was when he suffered a severe heatstroke, and now, after spending three days hospitalized with gastroenteritis, you have once again demonstrated the immense professionalism and compassion that characterize you.

Throughout his stay, you kept me informed of every step, how he was progressing, and all the decisions that needed to be made. You even allowed me to visit him for a couple of days to be with him, a gesture that meant so much to both of us.

I want to give a very special mention to Paz, his veterinarian. She is an absolute sweetheart with Tommy, and it's clear that she loves and cares for him as if he were her own. But I also want to thank the rest of the team, because every time Tommy comes through the door, there is always someone who greets him, gives him a pat, or says a few words. It's an atmosphere filled with love, and that, when you leave your loved one there, is priceless.

Furthermore, there's a detail that speaks volumes about your approach to this profession: you never refer to Tommy as his "owner," but rather as his "guardian." For me, that's very important, because Tommy isn't property; he's my life companion and a member of my family.

And, as if all this weren't enough, you were also the only ones to detect that Tommy had a brain tumor, something that marked a turning point in his care.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for caring for Tommy with such dedication, respect, and love. We will always be grateful and will never hesitate to recommend you.
